description:
Calculate the Pole of Inaccessibility for Somalia using the Natural Earth countries dataset.

1. Open QGIS (it should already be running).
2. Load the countries layer from /home/ga/GIS_Data/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.geojson.
3. Filter or select the feature for 'Somalia'.
4. To ensure accurate metric distance calculations, reproject the Somalia feature to EPSG:3857 (WGS 84 / Pseudo-Mercator).
5. Run the 'Pole of inaccessibility' tool (in Vector Geometry or via Processing Toolbox) on the reprojected Somalia layer. Use a tolerance of 1000 meters.
6. Save the resulting point feature as a GeoJSON file to /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/somalia_pole.geojson.
7. Check the attribute table of the result for the distance to the boundary. Create a text file at /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/distance_report.txt and write the distance in kilometers (e.g., 'Distance: 350.5 km').
